title: A board for one person: what is worth tracking and what is theatre

videos.script: Tools for managing a project are built for teams. Sprints, story points, velocity, burndown charts: each one answers a question a team of eight has, about who is doing what and whether they will finish together. {{teams}} A team of one has none of those questions. It has a smaller one: what was I going to do next, and what did I notice yesterday and forget? {{smaller}} This lesson builds the board that answers that, with three columns and one rule, and names the rest as what it is when one person does it: theatre. Then it ties the board to the code, so a reviewer who reads a commit can follow it back to the reason it was made.
